articles.title_en: Predicting and Preventing Gun Violence: An Experimental Evaluation of READI Chicago
articles.abstract_en: Gun violence is the most pressing public safety problem in U.S. cities. We report results from a randomized controlled trial (N = 2,456) of a community-researcher partnership called the Rapid Employment and Development Initiative (READI) Chicago. The program offered an 18-month job alongside cognitive behavioral therapy and other social support. Both algorithmic and human referral methods identified men with strikingly high scope for gun violence reduction: for every 100 people in the control group, there were 11 shooting and homicide victimizations during the 20-month outcome period. Fifty-five percent of the treatment group started programming, comparable to take-up rates in programs for people facing far lower mortality risk. After 20 months, there is no statistically significant change in an index combining three measures of serious violence, the study’s primary outcome. Yet there are signs that this program model has promise. One of the three measures, shooting and homicide arrests, declined 65% (p = .13 after multiple-testing adjustment). Because shootings are so costly, READI generated estimated social savings between ${\$}$182,000 and ${\$}$916,000 per participant (p = .03), implying a benefit-cost ratio between 4:1 and 18:1. Moreover, participants referred by outreach workers—a prespecified subgroup—saw enormous declines in arrests and victimizations for shootings and homicides (79% and 43%, respectively) which remain statistically significant even after multiple-testing adjustments. These declines are concentrated among outreach referrals with higher predicted risk, suggesting that human and algorithmic targeting may work better together.

articles.title_en: Eviction and Poverty in American Cities
articles.title_cn: 美国城市中的驱逐与贫困
articles.abstract_en: More than two million U.S. households have an eviction case filed against them each year. Policy makers at the federal, state, and local levels are increasingly pursuing policies to reduce the number of evictions, citing harm to tenants and high public expenditures related to homelessness. We study the consequences of eviction for tenants using newly linked administrative data from two major urban areas: Cook County (which includes Chicago) and New York City. We document that before housing court, tenants experience declines in earnings and employment and increases in financial distress and hospital visits. These pre trends pose a challenge for disentangling correlation and causation. To address this problem, we use an instrumental variables approach based on cases randomly assigned to judges of varying leniency. We find that an eviction order increases homelessness and hospital visits and reduces earnings, durable goods consumption, and access to credit in the first two years. Effects on housing and labor market outcomes are driven by effects for female and Black tenants. In the longer run, eviction increases indebtedness and reduces credit scores.
articles.abstract_cn: 每年有超过两百万美国家庭面临驱逐案件。联邦、州和地方各级政策制定者越来越多地推行减少驱逐数量的政策，理由是驱逐对租户造成伤害以及与无家可归相关的高额公共支出。我们使用来自两个主要城市地区（包括芝加哥的库克县和纽约市）的新关联行政数据，研究驱逐对租户的后果。我们记录了在住房法庭之前，租户经历收入下降、就业减少、财务困境和医院就诊增加。这些前期趋势对区分相关性和因果性构成挑战。为解决这一问题，我们采用基于随机分配给不同宽严程度法官的案件的工具变量方法。我们发现，驱逐令在头两年内增加了无家可归和医院就诊，减少了收入、耐用品消费和信贷获取。对住房和劳动力市场结果的影响主要由女性和黑人租户的效应驱动。在长期内，驱逐增加了债务并降低了信用评分。

articles.title_en: New Pricing Models, Same Old Phillips Curves?
articles.title_cn: 新定价模型，旧菲利普斯曲线？
articles.abstract_en: We show that in a broad class of menu cost models, the first-order dynamics of aggregate inflation in response to arbitrary shocks to aggregate costs are nearly the same as in Calvo models with suitably chosen Calvo adjustment frequencies. We first prove that the canonical menu cost model is first-order equivalent to a mixture of two time-dependent models, which reflect the extensive and intensive margins of price adjustment. We then show numerically that in any plausible parameterization, this mixture is well approximated by a single Calvo model. This close numerical fit carries over to other standard specifications of menu cost models. Thus, for shocks that are not too large, the Phillips curve for a menu cost model looks like the New Keynesian Phillips curve, but with a higher slope.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，在一大类菜单成本模型中，总体通胀对总成本任意冲击的一阶动态与在适当选择Calvo调整频率的Calvo模型中几乎相同。我们首先证明，典型的菜单成本模型在阶数上等价于两个时间依赖模型的混合，这两个模型分别反映了价格调整的广泛边际和集约边际。然后，我们在数值上表明，在任何合理的参数化下，这种混合可以很好地近似为单一的Calvo模型。这种紧密的数值拟合也适用于菜单成本模型的其他标准设定。因此，对于不太大的冲击，菜单成本模型的菲利普斯曲线看起来像新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线，但斜率更高。

articles.title_en: A Denial a Day Keeps the Doctor Away
articles.title_cn: 一天一次拒绝，医生远离我
articles.abstract_en: Who bears the consequences of administrative problems in health care? We use data on repeated interactions between a large sample of U.S. physicians and many different insurers to document the complexity of health care billing, and estimate its economic costs for doctors and consequences for patients. Observing the back-and-forth sequences of claim denials and resubmissions for past visits, we can estimate physicians’ costs of haggling with insurers to collect payments. Combining these costs with the revenue never collected, we estimate that physicians lose 18% of Medicaid revenue to billing problems, compared with 4.7% for Medicare and 2.4% for commercial insurers. Identifying off of physician movers and practices that span state boundaries, we find that physicians respond to billing problems by refusing to accept Medicaid patients in states with more severe billing hurdles. These hurdles are quantitatively just as important as payment rates for explaining variation in physicians’ willingness to treat Medicaid patients. We conclude that administrative frictions have first-order costs for doctors, patients, and equality of access to health care. We quantify the potential economic gains—in terms of reduced public spending or increased access to physicians—if these frictions could be reduced and find them to be sizable.
articles.abstract_cn: 谁承担医疗保健中行政问题的后果？我们利用美国大量医生与多家不同保险公司之间重复互动的数据，记录了医疗保健计费的复杂性，并估计了其对医生的经济成本及对患者的后果。通过观察过去就诊中索赔拒绝和重新提交的往返序列，我们可以估计医生与保险公司讨价还价以收取付款的成本。将这些成本与从未收取的收入相结合，我们估计医生因计费问题损失了18%的医疗补助收入，而医疗保险为4.7%，商业保险公司为2.4%。利用医生流动者和跨州执业的实践，我们发现医生通过拒绝接受医疗补助患者来应对计费问题，在计费障碍更严重的州。这些障碍在解释医生治疗医疗补助患者意愿的差异方面，与支付率同等重要。我们得出结论，行政摩擦对医生、患者和医疗保健获取的平等性具有一阶成本。我们量化了如果这些摩擦能够减少，潜在的经济收益——以减少公共支出或增加医生可及性来衡量——并发现这些收益是可观的。

articles.title_en: Trading Nontradables: The Implications of Europe’s Job-Posting Policy
articles.title_cn: 交易不可贸易品：欧洲职位派遣政策的含义
articles.abstract_en: This article examines the labor market implications of the EU posting policy, a large temporary migration program facilitated by the liberalization of the free provision of services in Europe. Posting allows EU firms to send (post) their employees abroad to export customer-facing services. Combining administrative data and quasi-experimental policy variation, I find that the policy permanently increased total factor mobility in Europe without crowding out traditional migration. This result suggests that unrealized gains from trade in factor services remained despite the absence of regulatory barriers to trade and migration in the EU. Furthermore, posted workers are mostly sent from low-wage countries to perform manual tasks in sectors formerly insulated from trade, and they represent a substantial share of EU migrant workers. In receiving countries, posting had persistent negative effects on employment for domestic workers in the more exposed sectors and local labor markets, but it had no effects on domestic wages. In low-wage sending countries, firms in formerly “nontradable” sectors experienced increased sales, profits, and tax payments when exporting services through posting. Posted workers earn more once sent abroad but remain paid at lower wages than comparable domestic workers in the receiving country. Wage gains for posted workers are mostly explained by minimum wages enforced by the EU policy, highlighting the role of labor market regulations in shaping the way gains from globalization are shared between labor and capital owners in origin countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了欧盟派遣政策的劳动力市场影响，该政策是通过欧洲服务自由提供的自由化而促成的临时性大规模移民项目。派遣允许欧盟企业将其员工派往国外以出口面向客户的服务。结合行政数据和准实验性政策变化，我发现该政策永久性地增加了欧洲的要素流动性，而没有挤出传统移民。这一结果表明，尽管欧盟在贸易和移民方面没有监管障碍，但要素服务贸易的未实现收益仍然存在。此外，派遣工人大多从低工资国家派往以前不受贸易影响的部门从事体力劳动，他们在欧盟移民工人中占相当大的比例。在接收国，派遣对更受影响的部门和地方劳动力市场中的国内工人就业产生了持续的负面影响，但对国内工资没有影响。在低工资派遣国，以前“不可贸易”部门的企业通过派遣出口服务时，销售额、利润和税收支付增加。派遣工人一旦被派往国外，收入会增加，但工资仍低于接收国可比国内工人。派遣工人的工资收益主要归因于欧盟政策强制执行的最低工资，这凸显了劳动力市场法规在塑造全球化收益如何在原籍国劳动力和资本所有者之间分配方面的作用。

articles.abstract_en: Policy makers, firms, and researchers often choose among multiple options based on estimates. Sampling error in the estimates used to guide choice leads to a winner’s curse, since we are more likely to select a given option precisely when we overestimate its effectiveness. This winner’s curse biases our estimates for selected options upward and can invalidate conventional confidence intervals. This article develops estimators and confidence intervals that eliminate this winner’s curse. We illustrate our results by studying selection of job-training programs based on estimated earnings effects and selection of neighborhoods based on estimated economic opportunity. We find that our winner’s curse corrections can make an economically significant difference to conclusions but still allow informative inference.
articles.abstract_cn: 政策制定者、企业和研究人员经常基于估计在多个选项中进行选择。用于指导选择的估计中的抽样误差会导致赢家诅咒，因为当某个选项的有效性被高估时，我们更有可能选择它。这种赢家诅咒会使我们对所选选项的估计向上偏误，并可能使常规置信区间失效。本文开发了消除这种赢家诅咒的估计量和置信区间。我们通过研究基于估计收入效应选择职业培训项目和基于估计经济机会选择社区来说明我们的结果。我们发现，我们的赢家诅咒修正可以对结论产生经济上显著的差异，但仍允许提供信息丰富的推断。

articles.title_en: An Economic Framework for Vaccine Prioritization
articles.title_cn: 疫苗优先分配的经济框架
articles.abstract_en: We propose an economic framework for determining the optimal allocation of a scarce supply of vaccines that become gradually available during a public health crisis, such as the COVID-19 pandemic. Agents differ in observable and unobservable characteristics, and the designer maximizes a social welfare function over all feasible mechanisms—accounting for agents’ characteristics, as well as their endogenous behavior in the face of the pandemic. The framework emphasizes the role of externalities and incorporates equity as well as efficiency concerns. Our results provide an economic justification for providing vaccines immediately and for free to some groups of agents, while at the same time showing that a carefully constructed pricing mechanism can improve outcomes by screening for individuals with the highest private and social benefits of receiving the vaccine. The solution casts light on the classic question of whether prices or priorities should be used to allocate scarce public resources under externalities and equity concerns.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个经济框架，用于确定在公共卫生危机（如COVID-19大流行）期间逐渐可获得的稀缺疫苗供应的最优分配。个体在可观察和不可观察的特征上存在差异，设计者在所有可行机制中最大化社会福利函数——考虑个体的特征以及他们在疫情面前的内生行为。该框架强调外部性的作用，并同时纳入公平和效率的考量。我们的结果为立即向某些群体免费提供疫苗提供了经济理由，同时表明，精心构建的定价机制可以通过筛选具有最高私人和社会疫苗收益的个体来改善结果。该解决方案阐明了在外部性和公平关切下，应使用价格还是优先权来分配稀缺公共资源的经典问题。

articles.title_en: Measuring Welfare and Inequality with Incomplete Price Information
articles.title_cn: 在不完全价格信息下衡量福利与不平等
articles.abstract_en: We propose and implement a new approach that allows us to estimate income-specific changes in household welfare in contexts where well-measured prices are not available for important subsets of consumption. Using rich but widely available expenditure survey microdata, we show that we can recover income-specific equivalent and compensating variations from horizontal shifts in what we call “relative Engel curves”—as long as preferences fall within the broad quasi-separable class (Gorman 1970, 1976). Our approach is flexible enough to allow for nonparametric estimation at each point of the income distribution. We apply the methodology to estimate inflation and welfare changes in rural India between 1987 and 2000. Our estimates reveal that lower rates of inflation for the rich erased the real income convergence found in the existing literature that uses the subset of consumption with well-measured prices to calculate inflation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出并实施了一种新方法，使得在重要消费子集缺乏精确测量价格的情况下，能够估计家庭福利的收入特定变化。利用丰富但广泛可得的支出调查微观数据，我们表明，只要偏好属于广义可分离类（Gorman 1970, 1976），我们就可以从我们所谓的“相对恩格尔曲线”的水平位移中恢复收入特定的等价变化和补偿变化。我们的方法足够灵活，允许在收入分布的每个点上进行非参数估计。我们将该方法应用于估计1987年至2000年间印度农村地区的通货膨胀和福利变化。我们的估计显示，富人较低的通货膨胀率消除了现有文献中发现的真实收入趋同，这些文献使用具有精确测量价格的消费子集来计算通货膨胀。

articles.title_en: Measuring Growth in Consumer Welfare with Income-Dependent Preferences: Nonparametric Methods and Estimates for the United States
articles.title_cn: 收入相关偏好下消费者福利增长的度量：非参数方法与美国的估计
articles.abstract_en: How should we measure changes in consumer welfare given observed data on prices and expenditures? This article proposes a nonparametric approach that holds under arbitrary preferences that may depend on observable consumer characteristics, for example, when expenditure shares vary with income. Using total expenditures under a constant set of prices as our money metric for real consumption (welfare), we derive a principled measure of real consumption growth featuring a correction term relative to conventional measures. We show that the correction can be nonparametrically estimated with an algorithm leveraging the observed, cross-sectional relationship between household-level price indices and household characteristics such as income. We demonstrate the accuracy of our algorithm in simulations. Applying our approach to data from the United States, we find that the magnitude of the correction can be large because of the combination of fast growth and lower inflation for income-elastic products. Setting reference prices in 2019, we find that (i) the uncorrected measure underestimates average real consumption per household in 1955 by 11.5%, and (ii) the correction reduces the annual growth rate from 1955 to 2019 by 18 basis points, which is larger than the well-known “expenditure-switching bias” over the same time horizon.
articles.abstract_cn: 给定价格和支出的观测数据，我们应如何度量消费者福利的变化？本文提出了一种非参数方法，该方法在任意可能依赖于可观测消费者特征（例如，当支出份额随收入变化时）的偏好下均成立。使用固定价格集合下的总支出作为实际消费（福利）的货币度量，我们推导出一个原则性的实际消费增长度量，其中包含相对于传统度量的修正项。我们证明，该修正项可以通过一种算法进行非参数估计，该算法利用家庭层面价格指数与家庭特征（如收入）之间可观测的横截面关系。我们在模拟中展示了我们算法的准确性。将我们的方法应用于美国数据，我们发现由于收入弹性产品的高增长和低通胀相结合，修正项的幅度可能很大。以2019年为参考价格，我们发现（i）未修正的度量低估了1955年每户平均实际消费11.5%，以及（ii）修正项使1955年至2019年的年增长率降低了18个基点，这大于同期众所周知的“支出转换偏差”。

articles.title_en: Measuring Welfare by Matching Households across Time
articles.title_cn: 通过跨期家庭匹配衡量福利
articles.abstract_en: The money metric utility function is an essential tool for calculating welfare-relevant growth and inflation. We show how to recover it from repeated cross-sectional data without making parametric assumptions about preferences. We do this by solving the following recursive problem. Given compensated demand, we construct money metric utility by integration. Given money metric utility, we construct compensated demand by matching households over time whose money metric utility value is the same. We illustrate our method using household consumption survey data from the United Kingdom from 1974 to 2017 and find that real consumption calculated using official aggregate inflation statistics overstates money metric utility in 1974 pounds for the poorest households by around 0.5% a year and understates it by around a third of a percentage point per year for the richest households. We extend our method to allow for missing or mismeasured prices, assuming preferences are separable between goods with well-measured prices and the rest. We discuss how our results change if the prices of some service sectors are mismeasured.
articles.abstract_cn: 货币度量效用函数是计算福利相关增长和通胀的重要工具。我们展示了如何在不设定偏好参数假设的情况下，从重复截面数据中恢复该函数。我们通过解决以下递归问题来实现这一点。给定补偿需求，我们通过积分构建货币度量效用。给定货币度量效用，我们通过匹配不同时期货币度量效用值相同的家庭来构建补偿需求。我们使用英国1974年至2017年的家庭消费调查数据来说明我们的方法，并发现使用官方总体通胀统计计算的真实消费，对于最贫困家庭，以1974年英镑计，每年高估货币度量效用约0.5%，而对于最富裕家庭，每年低估约三分之一个百分点。我们将方法扩展到允许价格缺失或测量错误的情况，假设偏好在对价格测量良好的商品与其他商品之间是可分离的。我们讨论了如果某些服务部门的价格测量错误，我们的结果将如何变化。

articles.title_en: Representation and Extrapolation: Evidence from Clinical Trials
articles.title_cn: 代表性与外推：来自临床试验的证据
articles.abstract_en: This article examines the consequences and causes of low enrollment of Black patients in clinical trials. We develop a simple model of similarity-based extrapolation that predicts that evidence is more relevant for decision-making by physicians and patients when it is more representative of the group being treated. This generates the key result that the perceived benefit of a medicine for a group depends not only on the average benefit from a trial but also on the share of patients from that group who were enrolled in the trial. In survey experiments, we find that physicians who care for Black patients are more willing to prescribe drugs tested in representative samples, an effect substantial enough to close observed gaps in the prescribing rates of new medicines. Black patients update more on drug efficacy when the sample that the drug is tested on is more representative, reducing Black-white patient gaps in beliefs about whether the drug will work as described. Despite these benefits of representative data, our framework and evidence suggest that those who have benefited more from past medical breakthroughs are less costly to enroll in the present, leading to persistence in who is represented in the evidence base.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了临床试验中黑人患者入组率低下的后果与原因。我们构建了一个基于相似性外推的简单模型，该模型预测，当证据对所治疗群体更具代表性时，其对医生和患者决策的相关性更高。这产生了关键结果：一种药物对某群体的感知获益不仅取决于试验中的平均获益，还取决于该群体患者在试验中的入组比例。在调查实验中，我们发现，照顾黑人患者的医生更愿意开具在代表性样本中测试过的药物，这一效应足以弥合观察到的处方率差距。当药物测试样本更具代表性时，黑人患者对药物疗效的更新更多，从而缩小了黑人与白人患者之间关于药物是否如描述般有效的信念差距。尽管代表性数据有这些益处，我们的框架和证据表明，那些从过去医学突破中获益更多的人在当前入组成本更低，导致证据基础中谁被代表具有持续性。

articles.title_en: Does Taxing Business Owners Affect Employees? Evidence From A Change in the Top Marginal Tax Rate
articles.title_cn: 对企业主征税会影响员工吗？最高边际税率变化的证据
articles.abstract_en: Debates about the taxation of business owners often center on the distributional effects of these taxes, particularly the degree to which they affect workers. Drawing on a new linked owner-firm-worker data set created from U.S. administrative tax records, I analyze how an increase in the top marginal tax rate faced by business owners affected the earnings of their employees. I use panel difference-in-differences methods to compare the earnings of workers in similar firms but whose owners were differentially exposed to the tax increase. I estimate that 11–18 cents per dollar of new business income tax liability was passed through to employee earnings. I find no change in employment in response to the tax increase. The responses were generally associated with lower earnings growth, not changes in workforce composition. The burden was not borne equally by all workers. Essentially all of the workers’ share of the burden was borne by those in the top 30% of the earnings distribution, highlighting that the ultimate distributional effects of the policy depend not only on the share of the burden borne by workers but on the shares borne by different types of workers. Furthermore, since the owners bore the majority of the burden, the policy resulted in a decrease in after-tax earnings inequality between top-bracket owners and lower-bracket workers. I discuss the implications of the findings for the mediating labor market mechanisms and for welfare analyses of income taxation using a marginal value of public funds framework.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于企业主税收的争论通常集中在这些税收的分配效应上，特别是它们对工人的影响程度。利用根据美国行政税务记录创建的新的所有者-公司-工人关联数据集，我分析了企业主面临的最高边际税率的增加如何影响其员工的收入。我使用面板双重差分法来比较类似公司中工人的收入，但这些公司的所有者受到增税的影响不同。我估计每美元新企业所得税负债 11-18 美分转嫁给员工收入。我发现就业没有因增税而发生变化。这些反应通常与收入增长放缓有关，而不是劳动力构成的变化。这一负担并非由所有工人平等承担。基本上，所有工人的负担份额都是由收入分配最顶层30%的人承担，这凸显了政策的最终分配效果不仅取决于工人负担的份额，还取决于不同类型工人承担的份额。此外，由于业主承担了大部分负担，该政策减少了顶层业主和底层工人之间的税后收入不平等。我讨论了研究结果对劳动力市场中介机制和使用公共资金边际价值框架的所得税福利分析的影响。
